title: Delete or wire up dead code kept alive only by its own tests: ContentResult and CalendarCycleDao's legacy methods
why: grep for ContentResult/ContentLoaded/ContentNotFound outside content_result.dart finds only test/story_acceptance/epic_19_offline_first_test.dart, which constructs and pattern-matches the type in isolation — no repository, service, or provider in lib/ ever returns or consumes a ContentResult; the content DAOs in this same batch (text_cache_dao.dart, daily_content_dao.dart) return plain nullable Future<T?> instead, exactly the shape ContentResult looks built to replace per EH-2's 'convert to a value at the data-layer boundary'. Likewise getCycleForProgramAndDate/getCyclesForDate/getCyclesForDateRange in calendar_cycle_dao.dart have zero callers anywhere in lib/ (grep confirms) — only content_database_comprehensive_test.dart's 'legacy method ... delegates' tests call them. In both cases a green test suite hides that the code has no real consumer; deleting either wouldn't be caught by any user-facing behavior change, only by the tests written specifically to keep them alive.
recommendation: Delete ContentResult/ContentLoaded/ContentNotFound and its test, or wire it into the content DAOs' return types if the EH-2 result-type pattern is actually wanted there. Delete calendar_cycle_dao.dart's 3 legacy methods and their delegate tests, or confirm via a repo-wide symbol search that nothing external depends on them before the next release.
acceptance_criteria: grep for ContentResult/ContentLoaded/ContentNotFound and for getCycleForProgramAndDate/getCyclesForDate/getCyclesForDateRange outside their own definition+test either returns a real production call site, or the symbols are deleted.
